 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = max(map(len, grid))
    # A uniform separator lies at the center of the panels; in the 9x5 demo,
    # the unique middle line is the 7 column (index 4), though earlier columns
    # happen to be uniform background too.
    candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        if all(len(row) > c for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1:
            candidates.append(c)
    if candidates:
        sep = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
        left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(sep, min(map(len, right)))
        left = [row[:width] for row in left]
        right = [row[:width] for row in right]
        ca = Counter(v for row in left for v in row)
        cb = Counter(v for row in right for v in row)
        bg_a, bg_b = ca.most_common(1)[0][0], cb.most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] and left[r][c] != bg_a and right[r][c] != bg_b else 4
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
    # Some tasks place the divider on a full uniform row.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    if rows:
        sep = min(rows, key=lambda r: abs(r - (h - 1) / 2))
        top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
        height = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        top, bottom = top[:height], bottom[:height]
        width = min(min(map(len, top)), min(map(len, bottom)))
        ca = Counter(v for row in top for v in row[:width])
        cb = Counter(v for row in bottom for v in row[:width])
        bg_a, bg_b = ca.most_common(1)[0][0], cb.most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] and top[r][c] != bg_a and bottom[r][c] != bg_b else 4
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
    raise ValueError("no separator found")
",
 "cross_profile": false
}

def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = max(map(len, grid))
    # The divider is a central monochrome row or column. Other uniform lines
    # can occur within a panel, so choose the candidate nearest the center.
    candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        if all(len(row) > c for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(c - (w - 1) / 2), "col", c))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(r - (h - 1) / 2), "row", r))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("no uniform divider")
    _, axis, k = min(candidates)

    if axis == "col":
        a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        b = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
        hh = h
        ww = min(min(map(len, a)), min(map(len, b)))
        a = [row[:ww] for row in a]
        b = [row[:ww] for row in b]
    else:
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
        hh = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:hh], b[:hh]
        ww = min(min(map(len, a)), min(map(len, b)))
        a = [row[:ww] for row in a]
        b = [row[:ww] for row in b]

    # Mark coordinates where the panels contain the same shared color.
    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    if not shared:
        raise ValueError("panels share no color")
    ca = Counter(v for row in a for v in row)
    cb = Counter(v for row in b for v in row)
    color = max(shared, key=lambda v: ca[v] + cb[v])
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(ww)] for r in range(hh)]
",

 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), max(map(len, grid))
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(len(row) > c for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]
    candidates = [(abs(r - (h - 1) / 2), "row", r) for r in row_seps]
    candidates += [(abs(c - (w - 1) / 2), "col", c) for c in col_seps]
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("no separator")
    _, axis, k = min(candidates)
    if axis == "col":
        a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        b = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
        height = h
        width = min(min(map(len, a)), min(map(len, b)))
    else:
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
        height = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:height], b[:height]
        width = min(min(map(len, a)), min(map(len, b)))
    a = [row[:width] for row in a[:height]]
    b = [row[:width] for row in b[:height]]
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    bg_a, bg_b = ca.most_common(1)[0][0], cb.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a[r][c] != bg_a and b[r][c] != bg_b else 8
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
